narrative: Material PL2__M63EDC15 exhibits an erratic daily demand pattern (mean 4317 units/day, CV 0.48) with no statistically significant trend over the observation period from March 2025 to March 2026. Lead times average 1.11 working days but are highly variable (CV=0.83), making lead-time variance the dominant driver of the safety stock requirement of 5702 units. An (r,Q) continuous-review policy is recommended with reorder point 10502 and order quantity 31094 units, which satisfies the 95% service-level target while remaining within the 36800-unit storage limit.
warnings: Significant demand variability (CV=0.48). Consider safety stock review each quarter.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is erratic (CV=0.48) with no intermittency, making a continuous-review (r,Q) model the standard choice. The EOQ minimises total annual ordering plus holding costs, and the reorder point incorporates combined demand-and-lead-time uncertainty via the sqrt-of-sum-of-variances safety stock formula, directly targeting the specified 95% service level.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage cap of 36800 units constrains OQ from 30454 to 31094. This reduces cycle stock and may marginally increase ordering frequency, but the service level impact is minor given the ample remaining capacity.
